entries.purpose: Calculate kinematic viscosity and vapor diffusivity of air based on temperature and pressure.
entries.source_title: An Introduction to Environmental Biophysics (2nd Ed)
entries.valid_domain: Standard terrestrial atmosphere temperatures and pressures.
assumptions: Ideal gas behavior for molar density.

entries.purpose: Calculate leaf boundary-layer conductance to water vapor using DOMINANT_MODE_APPROXIMATION.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: Sh = max(Sh_forced, Sh_free); g_bw = (D_v / d) * Sh * rho_m
entries.source_title: An Introduction to Environmental Biophysics (2nd Ed)
assumptions: Maximum of forced and free convection used for mixed regime approximation (DOMINANT_MODE_APPROXIMATION).
Free convection formula assumes heated horizontal upward-facing plate.
entries.approximation_status: mechanistic physics model with domain truncation
notes: Explicitly fails for turbulent regimes (Re > 20,000) returning UnsupportedFlowRegime. Re transition is an implementation domain, not a universal biological truth.

entries.purpose: Calculate total series vapor conductance and resultant transpiration flux.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: g_total = (g_s * g_b) / (g_s + g_b); E = g_total * (VPD / P_atm)
entries.valid_domain: Pressure > 0; boundary layer conductance must be Valid; returns 'condensation' status if VPD < 0.
assumptions: Mole fraction difference approximated via VPD/P_atm.
notes: Requires effective transpiring leaf area to be explicitly supplied for whole-plant aggregation.
